findings.detail: The flagged negative fair-value marks are shown in filing tables headed Unfunded Commitment and Fair Value, so they should carry unfunded-commitment classification rather than appear as unexplained negative holding fair values.
A second flagged negative fair-value amount is likewise source-presented in the unfunded commitment schedule, with positive unfunded commitment and negative fair value.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. C103 flags negative fair_value rows as unexplained when there is no matching negative cost or unfunded-commitment marker. The raw filing shows the relevant negative marks in tables whose header is Investments - non-controlled/non-affiliated | Commitment Type | Commitment Expiration Date | Unfunded Commitment | Fair Value. Those rows are valid filer presentation for unfunded commitments, but the extracted holding rows need the unfunded-commitment classification/marker; otherwise C103 correctly sees them as unexplained negative fair values. This is a real classification/lookthrough data error, not a fair-value amount error.
